purpose: Post-hoc Qwen initial estimate, not an independently audited formal grade.
input: Native synchronized video_url with embedded audio, 8fps, plus target marked still. No tested model identity or source answers disclosed.
labeling: Eight blind per-target annotations, independent of Sol predictions. Two target IDs per scene are not revealed together.
scoring: Existing 70F+20RN+10RB formula; model-generated reference remains audit pending; diagnostic_total only. No engineering points.
coverage: Four development queries plus four unseen-query reruns; also report development and unseen separately. A-Q1 renamed rerun is not double-counted.
qualification: Same native-video route: static identical visuals, silence, three bursts and five bursts; coarse counts/timing only. Not expert calibration or certification of object attribution and fine boundaries.
review: Four scene-level candidate-aware evidence audits after blind labels; do not silently edit first-pass labels based on desired score.
limitations: Single automatic labeler may miss or hallucinate audible events.
8fps imagery and judge timing do not certify 80ms boundary accuracy.
No high-quality input-only reference or modality ablation established.
